Order No.04 Dated- 15.05.2024 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. Apprehending his arrest in connection with Bindapathar P.S. Case No. 41 of 2023 instituted under Sections 498A, 109 and 494 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 3 and 4 of D.P. Act, the petitioner has moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
3. As per FIR, allegation is that the marriage of informant was solemnized with the petitioner in the year 2022.
After marriage, the informant told him to take her to the matrimonial home, but he started procrastinating it by one or the other reason.

It is further alleged that petitioner raised demand of Rs.30,000/- as additional dowry from the informant due to its non-fulfillment, he is not taking her matrimonial home and will solemnize second marriage, if it is not fulfilled.
It is further alleged that she was assaulted, when she tried to stop the petitioner from solemnizing second marriage.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case due to matrimonial dispute between the parties.

The real fact is that petitioner was already a married person and when he went to Bastipalajori with his friends, his marriage was again solemnized with the informant against his consent and also without knowledge of the family members.
Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the investigation of the case.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of allegation against petitioner coupled with materials available on record, I am inclined to extend privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender before the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Twenty five thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned J.M., 1st Class, Jamtara in connection with Bindapathar P.S. Case No. 41 of 2023 with the condition that he will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) Pappu/
